voice.preset_note: 可选：填 grok 内置音色名（如 "eve"），每段都用同一个声音，提示词改用 <AUDIO_0>、不再用 desc。可用的名字见 references/voice.md。null = 按 desc 由 grok 自己配音
voice.alt_clone: MiMo mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone，参照用 3 段 Grok 口播拼的 ≥12 秒干声（见 references/voice.md）

tts_ref.text: Right, What first is, I would say……两岸关系越紧张、越艰困，越需要沟通跟交流，so that's why…… 生生喝鲜奶、免费营养午餐
tts_ref.note: comfy 后端配音（scripts/tts_generate.py）克隆的参考音档和它的逐字稿。仓库里没有这个文件：放 10–30 秒本人或明确授权的干净朗读。2026-10-29 测试用的是 grok luna 的 10 秒试拍音轨，拿 AI 成品当克隆参考是否合乎服务条款没查，正式发布前换成授权录音。

model.name: grok-imagine-video-1.5
model.allowance_note: 占 grok 每周额度的百分比。2026-10-26 实测（X Premium+）：3 段共 28 秒 720p 用掉 7–9%（/usage 只显示整数）。480p 未实测。

comfy.note: 另一个后端：ComfyUI 上的 MiniMax H3（scripts/comfy_generate.py，build_tasks.py --backend comfy）。锁住每段给的音轨、只生成画面，提示词用 h3_prompt_template（不写台词，写了会烧字幕）。url 是内网 aikol，环境变量 COMFY_URL 优先。2026-10-27 用 10Eros 社区合并版实测（RTX 3090 Ti）：576×1024、10 秒一段约 186 秒；换官方权重就改下面的文件名，耗时和画质要重测。
comfy.lead_in_note: 每段音轨前垫几帧静音，生成后连同画面剪掉（6 帧 = 0.25 秒）。H3 开头 1–3 帧会从参考图跳成它自己画的脸，不垫的话段和段接缝处会闪一下；直接剪开头又会剪掉第一个字。0 = 不垫。

tts.note: comfy 后端的配音：scripts/tts_generate.py 经 ssh 到这台 GPU 机器跑 CosyVoice 3（Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512）零样本克隆，参考音档是各主播的 tts_ref。2026-10-29 在 aikol（RTX 3090 Ti）试听：比 VoxCPM2、IndexTTS-2.5、BlueMagpie-TTS 自然；用拼音强改平舌、本调反而刻意，所以台词照原文送。ssh_host 是内网 aikol，环境变量 TTS_SSH_HOST 优先（在外面用 aiko）。路径是那台机器上的，装法见 references/install.md。

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

hands_rest: below the bottom edge of the frame, out of view

gestures.note: 手势库：script.json 每段可以写 "gesture" 指定一种，没写的 full 段用 default，pip / vlog / depth 段沿用 acts。{hands_rest} 换成主播的 hands_rest（手平时放在哪里，每位主播各写一句）。来源是 awesome-talking-head-skills（MIT）拆的五位口播博主：liyifan = 李一帆 L1 低位摊手、qiuzhi = 秋芝 Q1 挥手、muzi = 木子 M1 外摊、xiaolin = 小Lin说 X4 侧掌、dashi = 大师 D1 抬手。qiuzhi / muzi / xiaolin 要双手在画面内的参考图（例如坐在主播台后的中景），自拍构图只用 liyifan / dashi。2026-10-30 H3 实拍（新闻棚中景，手放在桌上）：五种都没崩手；放在段首的手势时间点准，片中某一刻的手势次数和长度不准（xiaolin 做了两次，dashi 停 2 秒左右），所以一段只放一种，挥手、外摊放在开场段。

styles.liyifan: warm smile and steady eye contact, the emotion carried by the face: eyebrows lift on questions, a brief squint on the last word of each sentence, small nods. Both hands are {hands_rest} the whole time. Only once, on a question or a key point, one hand lifts a little, palm up, for about half a second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.qiuzhi: big warm smile and steady eye contact, small nods. At the start both hands rise beside the shoulders, palms facing the camera, fingers relaxed and together, and gently wave side to side twice as a greeting, then lower so both hands are {hands_rest}. After that both hands stay {hands_rest} with the elbows close to the body. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.muzi: smiling with raised eyebrows and steady eye contact. At the start both hands open outward from the chest to the sides, palms up and facing out, fingers naturally spread, wrists turning gently with the words for about two seconds, then lower so both hands are {hands_rest}. After that only a slight nod at the end of each phrase while both hands stay {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.xiaolin: expressive face, eyebrows lift and eyes widen on key words, leaning slightly forward. The left hand stays {hands_rest} the whole time. Once, while explaining, the right hand rises at the right side to chest height, palm facing inward and fingers together, moves in a small arc with the sentence for about one second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing
styles.dashi: eyebrows raised high and eyes wide with a pleasantly surprised look, clear mouth shapes, leaning slightly forward. Both hands are {hands_rest}. Once, on a key point, one hand rises to chest height, palm up, fingers relaxed and slightly curved, holds there for about half a second, then lowers again so both hands are {hands_rest}. No other hand gestures, no pointing

prompt_template:
The young woman in {ref} talks straight into her phone's front camera, same selfie framing, lighting and outfit as the reference, like a friendly Chinese tech vlogger {purpose}: {act}. Handheld selfie feel with only a very slight natural sway. She speaks Mandarin Chinese, clearly lip-synced, in {voice}:
“{line}”
Sound: only her voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
h3_prompt_template:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a vertical selfie close-up frames the young woman shown in <Picture 1>, preserving her face, eye shape, long black hair with loose strands beside her face, white ribbed tank top, the selfie angle, the natural indoor light and the room behind her. She holds the phone at arm's length and the camera shakes slightly at slow speed, keeping the same selfie framing. Like a friendly Taiwanese tech vlogger {purpose}, she looks straight into the lens: {act}. The young woman with a friendly, clear and lively voice (S1) speaks {language} directly into the phone camera, her lips moving in sync with every syllable of her voice.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone continues softly underneath her voice.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
h3_prompt_note: 2026-10-30 照 MiniMax 官方指南（MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 的 docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md）改写，other_hosts 里的 h3_prompt_template 也一样：第一行 I2VA 指令、三个字段（integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music）、说话的人标 (S1)、不写否定句。画面上的文字只在英文双引号里才会生成，所以台词不放进模板。
